KIDS’ WALLPAPER

Mayur (मयूर)

( Meaning “Peacock” in Sanskrit, symbolizing beauty, grace, and royalty. ) This vibrant Madhubani-style wallpaper features a majestic peacock standing amidst blooming flowers. The intricate detailing on the feathers, with eye-catching patterns in green, blue, and orange, highlights the bird’s elegance. The yellow background is adorned with flourishing trees and floral motifs, bringing a sense of festivity and natural harmony. The floral-bordered frame adds a finishing touch of richness. Ideal for spaces that radiate opulence and cultural sophistication.
